events.name: Texas Rangers at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Cedric Mullins hit a go-ahead home run in the eighth inning, Jonny DeLuca also went deep and seven pitchers combined on a two-hitter for the Tampa Bay Rays in a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cedric Mullins homers in the eighth inning, lifting Rays over the Rangers 3-2

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Kody Clemens hit a game-ending grand slam with two outs in the ninth inning as the Minnesota Twins beat the Kansas City Royals 4-3 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kody Clemens hits a walk-off grand slam with 2 outs in the 9th to send the Twins past the Royals 4-3

events.name: New York Yankees at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Tristan Peters drew a bases-loaded walk in the 11th inning to force in automatic runner Chase Meidroth and the Chicago White Sox edged the Yankees 2-1 on Thursday, beating New York in extra innings for a second straight game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tristan Peters' bases-loaded walk in 11th lifts White Sox over Yankees 2-1

events.name: Chicago Cubs at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Alex Bregman drove in the go-ahead run with a 10th-inning double and the Chicago Cubs went on to a 4-2 win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bregman lifts Cubs to 4-2 victory over Cardinals in 10 innings.

headlines.description: — Ronald Acuña Jr. and Mike Yastrzemski homered and the Atlanta Braves overcame a three-run deficit to beat the Washington Nationals 5-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves overcome 3-run deficit to beat the Nationals 5-4

events.name: Miami Marlins at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Luis Robert Jr. had a two-run single to cap an eighth-inning rally in the New York Mets' 4-2 victory over the Miami Marlins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robert has a 2-run single in the 8th to lift the Mets past the Marlins, 4-2

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz scored on fielder's choice in the ninth inning to lift the Cincinnati Reds to a 3-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Thursday night in the opening game of a four-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elly De La Cruz scores in the ninth as the Reds beat the Pirates 3-2

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — The Boston Red Sox failed in their bid for a second winning streak of 10 or more games in the same season, losing to the Athletics 7-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox bid for 2nd win streak of 10 or more games ends in 7-3 loss to Athletics

events.name: San Francisco Giants at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Rookie Daniel Susac hit a two-run home run and had three RBI, and Robbie Ray pitched six impressive innings to win his seventh straight decision and lead the San Francisco Giants to a 4-1 victory over the San Diego Padres on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Susac homers again, Ray wins his 7th straight decision as Giants beat Padres 4-1

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Dalton Rushing hit a three-run homer, Teoscar Hernández added a solo shot and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Seattle Mariners 6-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rushing and Hernández go deep as the Dodgers beat the Mariners 6-2
